rules.title: SQL Injection via String Concatenation
rules.description: SQL query built with string concatenation may be vulnerable to SQL injection.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements.

rules.title: SQL Injection via String Formatting
rules.description: SQL query built with string formatting may be vulnerable to SQL injection.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or ORM.

rules.title: XSS via innerHTML
rules.description: Setting innerHTML with unsanitized data can lead to XSS.
rules.recommendation: Use textContent or sanitize with DOMPurify.

rules.title: XSS via document.write
rules.description: document.write with user data can lead to XSS.
rules.recommendation: Use safe DOM manipulation methods.

rules.title: Code Injection via eval()
rules.description: eval() executes arbitrary code and is extremely dangerous.
rules.recommendation: Use JSON.parse() for data or Function constructor with strict validation.

rules.title: Code Injection via Function Constructor
rules.description: Function constructor can execute arbitrary code.
rules.recommendation: Avoid dynamic code generation. Use safe alternatives.

rules.title: Command Injection
rules.description: Command execution with string concatenation may allow command injection.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized commands or avoid shell execution.

rules.title: Path Traversal
rules.description: File operations with user input may allow path traversal.
rules.recommendation: Validate and sanitize file paths. Use allowlists.

rules.title: Weak Cryptographic Hash (MD5)
rules.description: MD5 is cryptographically broken and should not be used for security.
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or bcrypt for hashing.

rules.title: Weak Cryptographic Hash (SHA1)
rules.description: SHA1 is considered weak for security purposes.
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger.

rules.title: Weak Encryption (DES/3DES)
rules.description: DES and 3DES are deprecated encryption algorithms.
rules.recommendation: Use AES-256-GCM for encryption.

rules.title: Weak Encryption (RC4)
rules.description: RC4 has known vulnerabilities and should not be used.
rules.recommendation: Use AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20.

rules.title: Insecure Random Number Generator
rules.description: Non-cryptographic RNGs should not be used for security tokens.
rules.recommendation: Use crypto.randomBytes() or secrets module.

rules.title: SSL/TLS Verification Disabled
rules.description: Disabling SSL verification exposes connections to MITM attacks.
rules.recommendation: Always verify SSL certificates in production.

rules.title: Insecure CORS (Wildcard)
rules.description: Wildcard CORS allows any origin to access your API.
rules.recommendation: Specify exact allowed origins.

rules.title: Debug Mode Enabled
rules.description: Debug mode in production can expose sensitive information.
rules.recommendation: Disable debug mode in production.

rules.title: Hardcoded IP Address
rules.description: Hardcoded IP addresses reduce flexibility and may expose internal infrastructure.
rules.recommendation: Use environment variables or configuration files.

rules.title: Insecure HTTP URL
rules.description: HTTP URLs transmit data in plaintext.
rules.recommendation: Use HTTPS for all external communication.

rules.title: Weak JWT Algorithm (none)
rules.description: JWT with 'none' algorithm bypasses signature verification.
rules.recommendation: Always use RS256 or HS256 and validate the algorithm.

rules.title: Session Cookie Without Secure Flag
rules.description: Session cookies without Secure flag can be sent over HTTP.
rules.recommendation: Set Secure flag on all session cookies.

rules.title: Session Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag
rules.description: Cookies without HttpOnly can be accessed by JavaScript.
rules.recommendation: Set HttpOnly flag on session cookies.

rules.title: Weak Password Validation
rules.description: Password minimum length is too short.
rules.recommendation: Require minimum 12 characters with complexity rules.

rules.title: XML External Entity (XXE) Vulnerability
rules.description: XML parsers that process external entities are vulnerable to XXE.
rules.recommendation: Disable external entity processing in XML parsers.

rules.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
rules.description: HTTP requests with user-controlled URLs may enable SSRF.
rules.recommendation: Validate and restrict URLs to allowed domains.

rules.title: Unsafe Deserialization
rules.description: Deserializing untrusted data can lead to remote code execution.
rules.recommendation: Use safe deserialization methods or validate input.

rules.title: Insecure Temporary File Creation
rules.description: Predictable temporary file names can be exploited.
rules.recommendation: Use mkstemp() or tempfile module.

rules.title: Sensitive Data in Logs
rules.description: Sensitive data should not be written to logs.
rules.recommendation: Redact sensitive data before logging.
rules.owasp: A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

rules.title: Missing Rate Limiting
rules.description: API endpoints without rate limiting are vulnerable to abuse.
rules.recommendation: Implement rate limiting on all API endpoints.

rules.title: Unsafe postMessage
rules.description: postMessage handler without origin validation.
rules.recommendation: Always validate the origin in message event handlers.

rules.title: Missing CSRF Protection
rules.description: CSRF protection is disabled.
rules.recommendation: Enable CSRF protection for state-changing operations.

rules.title: Open Redirect
rules.description: Redirects using user input can enable phishing.
rules.recommendation: Validate redirect URLs against an allowlist.

rules.title: NoSQL Injection
rules.description: NoSQL queries with user input may be injectable.
rules.recommendation: Sanitize input and use parameterized queries.

rules.title: LDAP Injection
rules.description: LDAP queries with user input may be injectable.
rules.recommendation: Escape special characters in LDAP queries.

rules.title: HTTP Header Injection
rules.description: HTTP headers set from user input may enable header injection.
rules.recommendation: Validate and sanitize header values.

rules.title: Regular Expression DoS (ReDoS)
rules.description: Complex regex patterns may cause catastrophic backtracking.
rules.recommendation: Use simpler regex or set timeouts.

rules.title: Unsafe Reflection
rules.description: Dynamic attribute access with user input is dangerous.
rules.recommendation: Use allowlists for dynamic attribute access.

rules.title: Mass Assignment Vulnerability
rules.description: Directly passing user input to model creation enables mass assignment.
rules.recommendation: Use explicit field allowlists.

rules.title: Insecure Cookie Configuration
rules.description: Cookie security flags are not properly set.
rules.recommendation: Set Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite flags.

rules.title: Error Message Information Leak
rules.description: Stack traces in error responses leak implementation details.
rules.recommendation: Return generic error messages to clients.

rules.title: Console.log in Production Code
rules.description: Console statements should be removed from production code.
rules.recommendation: Use a proper logging library.
rules.owasp: A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

rules.title: Security TODO/FIXME Comment
rules.description: Security-related TODO comments indicate unresolved issues.
rules.recommendation: Address security TODOs before deployment.

rules.title: Disabled Input Sanitization
rules.description: Input sanitization is explicitly disabled.
rules.recommendation: Always sanitize user input.

rules.title: Weak HMAC Algorithm
rules.description: HMAC with weak hash algorithms provides insufficient security.
rules.recommendation: Use HMAC with SHA-256 or stronger.

rules.title: Authentication Disabled
rules.description: Authentication is explicitly disabled.
rules.recommendation: Enable authentication for all protected routes.

rules.title: Unsafe HTML Rendering
rules.description: Rendering raw HTML from user input enables XSS.
rules.recommendation: Sanitize HTML or use safe rendering methods.

rules.title: JWT Without Expiration
rules.description: JWT tokens without expiration never expire.
rules.recommendation: Always set token expiration.

rules.title: Timing Attack Vulnerable Comparison
rules.description: String comparison for secrets is vulnerable to timing attacks.
rules.recommendation: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual() or hmac.compare_digest().
